name: cooperative-1881-per-level-geometry-20260711
goal: Replace invalid Cooperative 1881 floor footprints with source-bound, sheet-specific A-101 through A-108 geometry and A-201 elevations so the 3D building is extruded from each actual level rather than a repeated or fragmentary proxy.
sources_of_truth: Y:/Shared/HaloOps/02-Active jobs/Kier/The Cooperative 1881 - Salt Lake City UT/2-Internal Ops/01-Design/04-GC PDF Plans & Specs
exit_criteria: All eight levels bind their own A-101 through A-108 physical page, rendered-page hash, printed scale, and A-201 elevation receipt.
Every emitted footprint is a simple non-self-crossing polygon whose shoelace area agrees with its reported area within a declared raster tolerance.
No level uses another level's footprint or an x8 quantity multiplier as a substitute for per-level geometry.
The Level 3 footprint is independently checked against the 22,359.12 square foot area printed on A-103 without fitting the extractor to that target.
Fallback rectangles and incomplete connected-component traces stay blocked unless explicitly source-bounded and independently validated.
The building assembly extrudes each validated footprint at the source-bound elevations 0, 10, 20, 31, 41, 51, 61, and 71 feet.
Level 8 geometry can be registered to FP-8 for subsequent node-by-node sprinkler comparison.
Adversarial, focused/full regression, build, formal, browser, and live deployment gates pass before closing this slice.
